program.name: Back Reset 35
program.subject: Back care
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of back care: upper back and neck, or lower back and hips.
program.about: Back care split top and bottom. One day strengthens the upper back and neck with Y raises, snow angels and chin tucks, then a shoulder flow; the other the lower back and hips with the big three, glutes and a hip flow. They alternate. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Upper back & neck / lower back & hips, 35 minutes
